purpose: Govern evidence-backed current-development observations before analytical interpretation, without mutating Canonical, Calendar, Source/Change Monitor or Analysis state.

pre_analysis_semantics.current_state: A derived as-of view over verified observations. It is not a separate causal conclusion and is not persisted as an authoritative truth object in v0.1.
pre_analysis_semantics.developing_story: Potential grouping of multiple observations. AV does not create story identities or automatic clustering; a later specimen must prove the grouping contract is needed.
pre_analysis_semantics.market_reaction: A market price, yield, spread, volume or probability observation may be recorded factually when rights and evidence permit. Attribution of that movement to a catalyst is prohibited here and belongs in Analysis.
pre_analysis_semantics.competing_explanation: Live Intelligence may retain contemporaneous context observations that could later support alternatives. Ranking them as explanations or choosing a preferred cause belongs in Analysis.
pre_analysis_semantics.confidence: Live Intelligence expresses factual verification through verification_state. Analytical confidence and causal confidence are prohibited.

guardrails: Live Intelligence stores evidence-backed factual observations, not causal interpretation.
A Live Intelligence observation may exist without a canonical occurrence when the development is genuinely unscheduled.
A canonical link must resolve to a real occurrence when one is supplied.
Source failure, source absence and parser failure are Source/Change Monitor states and cannot themselves create Live Intelligence facts.
Monitor candidates do not automatically become Live Intelligence observations.
Live Intelligence evidence cannot change canonical provenance or resolve missing canonical timing.
Observation time, source publication time and real-world event time are distinct concepts.
Authoritative local event time and IANA timezone should be preserved when available; Melbourne time is never canonicalised.
Corrections to prior Live Intelligence observations preserve and link to the prior observation explicitly.
An external data revision may be observed without inventing a historical Live Intelligence row that never existed.
Repeated reports do not automatically become one story, one causal signal or one canonical event.
Market observations may be factual observations, but attribution of a move to a catalyst belongs in Analysis.
Existing Analysis evidence is not retroactively migrated merely to populate this layer.
Automatic canonical commit and Google Calendar write remain prohibited.
Evidence source-publication time uses explicit precision and may not be upgraded from a civil date to a fabricated clock time.
AW v0.2 opens only a controlled single-specimen population; a later pressure audit is required before any second observation or broader ingestion.
Public observation projection and runtime-feed claims remain prohibited in the controlled first-specimen state.

foundation_checkpoint.historical_contract: AV v0.1 established the executable zero-population foundation and closed production/public population pending a real pressure-audited specimen.

population_policy.reason: AW opens only enough population authority for one reviewed Nepal physical-shock specimen. A later pressure audit is required before any second observation or broader ingestion.
